services.name: Art Exhibits
services.desc: Exhibits in the King Gallery are co-sponsored by the College of Southern Idaho Art Department and Associated Students of CSI. This schedule is subject to change without notice. The Jean B. King Gallery of Art, in cooperation with the College of Southern Idaho Arts and Humanities Department and the Herrett Center for Arts and Science, offers exhibitions and programs which showcase contemporary art and art issues. The gallery presents national and international exhibitions and supporting programs that expand community awareness of the visual arts while also striving to recognize and promote visual artists residing in Idaho. services.name: Rental
services.desc: The College of Southern Idaho welcomes use of the Herrett Center facilities for community events. The facility and equipment are available for fees that cover operational and maintenance costs and do not offer unfair competition with other event venues in the community. As a science center and museum, the Herrett’s primary mission is to provide educational programs for the public. For this reason, special events cannot take precedence over regularly scheduled programming, and use of the facility must take into account the protection of irreplaceable collections and sensitive equipment.
